description: Configuration required before the Ed-Fi backpack can connect to an ODS instance.

sections.label: ODS Connection
sections.description: Credentials and endpoint for the Ed-Fi ODS instance.

fields.label: Connection Name
fields.description: Unique identifier for this ODS connection. Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

fields.label: ODS Base URL
fields.description: Root URL of the Ed-Fi ODS instance. Do not include /data/v3 or trailing slash.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: OAuth2 client ID issued by the Ed-Fi ODS administrator.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: OAuth2 client secret issued with the client id. Never commit to git; provided at install only. Stored only under runtime/ on this machine.

fields.label: Key access level
fields.description: What this client id/secret is allowed to do on the ODS (as issued by the ODS admin). read = report/read only; limited = subset of resources; full = broad read. Nova still never writes to the ODS. Does not replace Nova Shell user grants.

sections.label: District / region scope
sections.description: TEA ODS client credentials are usually statewide (can reach many districts). Nova still requires a scope policy: which LEA(s) THIS install is allowed to pull. District = one LEA. Region = explicit allowed LEA list.

fields.label: Scope mode
fields.description: single_lea = one district filter. multi_lea = region/ESC: same kind of key, multiple allowed LEAs (Nova policy, not a special key type).

fields.label: Primary District LEA ID
fields.description: Required for single_lea. PEIMS form (031901) or Ed-Fi form (31901) both work — they match the same district. For multi_lea, optional default LEA when a query does not pass district_lea_id.

fields.label: Allowed LEA IDs (region)
fields.description: Region mode: comma-separated LEAs this Nova may query. The ODS key may still see the whole state; Nova will refuse LEAs outside this list.

sections.label: Local warehouse (daily full pull)
sections.description: TEA rate-limits forbid back-to-back live pulls. Nova stores full LEA data in a local SQLite warehouse and promotes it on a schedule. User reports read local data.

fields.label: Enable scheduled warehouse sync
fields.description: When on, Nova may run one full LEA schools pull per day in the configured hour (not on every click).

fields.label: Preferred local sync hour (0-23)
fields.description: Local clock hour to prefer for the daily full pull (e.g. 2 = 2:00 AM).

fields.label: Minimum hours between full syncs
fields.description: Hard gap so accidental restarts cannot hammer TEA. Default ~once per day.

fields.label: Resources to sync
fields.description: Comma-separated. Phase 1: schools. Students and others come later with the same warehouse model.

sections.label: Advanced
sections.description: Override defaults only if your ODS uses non-standard paths or SSL configuration.

fields.label: Token Endpoint Path
fields.description: Path to the OAuth2 token endpoint relative to base_url.

fields.label: API Root Path
fields.description: Path to the Ed-Fi data API root relative to base_url.

fields.label: Metadata Path
fields.description: Path to the resource metadata endpoint, appended after api_root.

fields.label: Verify SSL Certificate
fields.description: Disable only for self-signed certs in controlled environments.

fields.label: CA Bundle Path
fields.description: Path to a custom CA bundle file (.pem) for SSL verification.

install_steps.description: Validate all required fields are present and well-formed.
Authenticate with the ODS and discover available resources. Saves capability profile to runtime/edfi/profiles/{connection_id}.json.
Confirm LEA ID returns at least one school record. Fails if district scoping returns empty.
